description: Four channel stereo mixer with pan, mute, solo, two stereo aux buses and CV over level, pan and mute, expandable with ExFor and ExTwo modules placed to its left

params.text: Sets the level of the main stereo output, with an audio taper and up to 6dB of gain fully clockwise
Silences the main stereo output, with a smoothing filter that stops the cut from clicking
Sets that channel's level on an audio taper: logarithmic over the top three quarters, -18dB at a quarter turn, and straight down to silence below that
Pans that channel between the left and right main outputs on an equal-power law
Silences that channel, with a smoothing filter that stops the cut from clicking; a solo on any channel overrides it
Plays that channel alone and clears the solo on the others; control-click, or command-click on a Mac, adds the channel to the solo instead of replacing it
Sets how much of that channel is mixed into aux bus 1, taken after the level, pan and mute controls unless the menu switches send 1 to pre-fader
Sets how much of that channel is mixed into aux bus 2, taken after the level, pan and mute controls unless the menu switches send 2 to pre-fader
Sets the level of the aux bus 1 return as it is mixed into the main output, with an audio taper and up to 6dB of gain fully clockwise
Sets the level of the aux bus 2 return as it is mixed into the main output, with an audio taper and up to 6dB of gain fully clockwise

inputs.text: The channel's audio input; a polyphonic cable is mixed down to mono and the level normalised
Scales that channel's level, 0V silencing it and 10V leaving the level knob alone, smoothed so that fast changes do not click
Shifts that channel's pan, 5V moving it fully right and -5V fully left, added to the pan knob and smoothed so that fast changes do not click
Mutes that channel while the voltage is above 1.6V and un-mutes it below 0.8V, or toggles the mute on each rising edge when the menu is set that way
Returns aux bus 1 from whatever the send feeds, scaled by the R1 knob and mixed into the main output
Returns aux bus 2 from whatever the send feeds, scaled by the R2 knob and mixed into the main output

outputs.text: The main stereo mix, after the master level knob and master mute
That channel's own signal after its level knob and mute, carrying no pan and none of the other channels
The sum of every channel's aux 1 send, for patching to an effect whose output comes back at the R1 jacks
The sum of every channel's aux 2 send, for patching to an effect whose output comes back at the R2 jacks

notes: the three items on the right-click menu apply only to the channels of the module you right-clicked; every expander in the row carries its own copy of them
ExFor and ExTwo expanders go to the left of this module, touching it or each other in an unbroken row; a gap of one module breaks the chain and the expanders beyond it are cut off
menu: Send 1 Pre-Fader — takes the aux 1 sends from before the level and pan controls, so the fader no longer changes them while mute and solo do
Send 2 Pre-Fader — takes the aux 2 sends from before the level and pan controls, so the fader no longer changes them while mute and solo do
Mute CV toggles on/off — makes each rising edge at a mute CV jack flip the mute, in place of muting while the gate is high

inputs.12: high above 1.6V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.13: high above 1.6V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.14: high above 1.6V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.15: high above 1.6V · stepped · one channel only
